header.source: OKX Proof of Reserves — published wallet-address file (report of 1 Nov 2026, 00:00 UTC+8), network TRON; every address in the file carries a signed message ("I am an OKX address" or "I am an Okcoin address")
header.license: No licence is stated for the address file on the OKX download page; the addresses are an official public disclosure by the exchange. Only addresses and the snapshot reference are reproduced here.
header.selection: rows with Network=TRON and coin USDT-TRC20 or TRX holding >= 100,000 units at the snapshot (79 wallets). The file lists ~474,000 TRON addresses; the small ones are per-user deposit addresses and are left to the deposit-sweep heuristic (CEX_DEPOSIT).
